title: Configuration embedded in the second branch
statement: Let $N_0$ and $N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ be a Boolean input string. A configuration of $N_1$ on $x$ is sent to a configuration of their combined machine on the same input by embedding its state in the second summand (preserving a halting state), retaining its input-head position and output, and placing its work tapes and head positions in the second block. Every tape in the first block is blank at every position and has its head at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Two finite nondeterministic Turing machines over Bool
A configuration of the second machine on that input
